```plaintext
Set up Clanker QA tester auth for yyot so Codex can post to Slack as yyovil and Tanishq Palandurkar (normal users) and assign tasks to Clanker. Workspace: clanker-global (T0C6J1XCDE0). App under test: existing Clanker app A0C78PBUKQQ — do NOT create a separate Slack app.Goal: per-tester User OAuth Tokens (xoxp-) from the Clanker app in `.local/clanker-qa/.env`, then admit those API posts via api_human_users.Never ask me to paste tokens in chat. I put them in the file myself. Don’t commit secrets.## Steps1. Read `~/.codex/skills/clanker-qa/SKILL.md` and note which user scopes the driver needs (at least: chat:write, channels:history, channels:read, groups:history, groups:read, im:history, im:read, files:read, reactions:read — match the QA manifest’s user scopes).2. On the existing Clanker Slack app (api.slack.com/apps → clanker / A0C78PBUKQQ):   - Add those scopes under **User Token Scopes** (OAuth & Permissions). Do not remove bot scopes Clanker already uses.   - Reinstall / re-authorize to the workspace if Slack requires it for the new scopes.   - Document exactly which scopes were added and what I must click to reinstall.3. Obtain a user token for each person (same Clanker app, two authorizations):   - Sign into Slack as Tanishq Palandurkar → authorize the Clanker app for user scopes → copy that user’s `xoxp-` → put in     `/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/.local/clanker-qa/.env` as `CLANKER_QA_TANISHQ_USER_TOKEN`   - Sign in as yyovil → same → `CLANKER_QA_YYOVIL_USER_TOKEN`   Pause so I can do each login and edit the file. Prefer the app’s OAuth “Install / Reinstall” or Add to Slack user-token flow; if the app only has bot install today, walk me through enabling user OAuth on this app without creating a new app.4. Verify with:   `Q=/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/.codex/skills/clanker-qa/scripts/qa`   `$Q doctor`   Identity must be U0C688SF7DZ (tanishq) and U0C6M6DMWAW (yyovil) in team T0C6J1XCDE0. Fix scopes/DM/#clanker-test membership as needed.5. Allowlist those users so Hermes doesn’t drop Web API user posts as bots:   `$Q setup-gateway` then `$Q setup-gateway --apply`, then `$Q restart` only when idle (per skill). Re-check `$Q doctor` / `$Q status`.6. Summarize what’s done, what’s left, and the exact command to start testing.Constraints: no second Slack app; don’t use Clanker’s bot token to simulate users; don’t expand into batch/parallel skill work unless I ask. If SKILL.md still says “create one Slack app per tester,” update only the Setup section to describe reusing Clanker’s app + user OAuth, then stop.
```

explain what this prompt is asking agent to do in normal human lang
I’ll use your `$i-have-adhd` response style to explain it in plain language.

It’s asking an agent to **let Codex test Clanker by sending Slack messages as your two real user accounts: Tanishq and yyovil.**

Here’s what that means:

1. **Check what access the tester needs.** Read the Clanker QA instructions and identify the Slack permissions required to send messages and read conversations, files, and reactions.

2. **Enable that access on the existing Clanker app.** Add permissions for user accounts without removing Clanker’s existing bot permissions. Re-authorize the app if Slack requires it. **Do not create another Slack app.**

3. **Pause for you to connect each account.** You log in and authorize Clanker separately as Tanishq and yyovil. Each account gets its own secret access token, which you put into the local `.env` file yourself. You never paste tokens into chat, and the agent must not commit them to Git.

4. **Verify both accounts work.** Run the QA checker to confirm the tokens belong to the correct people and workspace, have the necessary permissions, and can access the required test channel and direct messages.

5. **Tell Clanker to accept those test messages.** Clanker’s gateway might otherwise ignore messages sent through an API as bot traffic. Allowlist both accounts, restart only when Clanker is idle, and report what’s ready plus the command to begin testing.

**One important catch:** If the QA instructions still say “create one Slack app per tester,” the agent must **only update the Setup section to describe reusing Clanker’s app, then stop**. It must not continue with authentication setup in that run.

The requested outcome is **working access for future testing**, not running a batch of tests yet.
